intro: The Cucumber Mint Lime (16 oz) from CAVA is a refreshing handcrafted beverage that combines cool cucumber juice, fresh mint, zesty lime juice, and a touch of cane sugar. At $3.45 and 180 calories, this drink offers a light and invigorating complement to any meal from the [full CAVA menu](/). Perfect for those seeking a naturally flavored alternative to traditional soft drinks.
priceCalories: Priced at $3.45 for a 16 oz serving, the Cucumber Mint Lime contains 180 calories with 44g of carbs, 1g of protein, and 0g of fat. This makes it a moderate-calorie beverage choice compared to other options on the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks). The calorie content comes primarily from natural cane sugar, providing quick energy without added fats or artificial sweeteners.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets this drink apart is its unique combination of fresh, garden-inspired ingredients. The cucumber juice provides hydrating properties while mint adds a cooling sensation and lime brings brightness. Unlike mass-produced beverages, CAVA uses real fruit juices and herbs without artificial flavors or colors, creating an authentic taste experience that pairs perfectly with Mediterranean flavors throughout the menu.
nutritionFacts: Each 16 oz serving delivers 180 calories with a macronutrient breakdown of 44g carbohydrates, 1g protein, and 0g fat. The drink is naturally fat-free and provides hydration through its cucumber base. While it contains 44g of carbs from natural cane sugar and fruit juices, it offers a lighter alternative to many fountain drinks. Check the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) for personalized meal planning.
whatsInside: The Cucumber Mint Lime features four simple ingredients: cucumber juice for hydration and subtle earthiness, fresh mint leaves for aromatic coolness, lime juice for citrus tang, and cane sugar for balanced sweetness. This straightforward ingredient list reflects CAVA's commitment to real food without artificial additives. The cucumber and mint combination creates a spa-like refreshment that cleanses the palate between bites.
tasteLike: The flavor profile is crisp, refreshing, and perfectly balanced between sweet and tart. The cucumber provides a clean, subtle base that does not overpower, while mint adds herbal coolness and lime contributes bright citrus notes. The cane sugar rounds out the flavors without making it overly sweet. The overall taste is light, garden-fresh, and reminiscent of upscale spa water with enhanced flavor complexity.
customize: The Cucumber Mint Lime comes as a crafted beverage with a set recipe to ensure consistent quality. While customization options are limited for this prepared drink, you can request light ice for more beverage or extra ice for maximum chill. Consider ordering alongside items from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) or [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas) to create your perfect meal combination.
pairsWell: This refreshing beverage pairs excellently with spicy or richly seasoned dishes from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) like Spicy Lamb Meatballs or Harissa Chicken. The cooling cucumber and mint help balance heat while lime cuts through rich flavors. It also complements fresh salads and grain bowls, enhancing the vegetable-forward nature of many CAVA meals. Try it with Mediterranean sides for a complete dining experience.
healthyChoice: With zero fat and natural ingredients, the Cucumber Mint Lime is a healthier beverage choice compared to sodas or artificially flavored drinks. The cucumber provides hydration and trace nutrients, while mint may aid digestion. At 180 calories, it is moderate in energy content. Those monitoring sugar intake should note the 44g carbs. For lower-calorie options, explore the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for detailed nutritional information.
howToOrder: Order the Cucumber Mint Lime (16 oz) at any [CAVA Locations](/locations) by requesting it at the beverage station or cashier. It comes pre-made in a 16 oz size for $3.45. Simply add it to your order when building your bowl, pita, or salad. The drink is served cold and ready to enjoy immediately, making it a convenient addition to your meal without preparation wait time.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Classic Lemonade (16 oz) at 260 calories, the Cucumber Mint Lime offers 80 fewer calories while providing a more herbaceous, sophisticated flavor profile. The Blueberry Lavender (16 oz) at 140 calories is slightly lighter but offers a fruitier, floral taste. The Cucumber Mint Lime stands out with its savory-sweet balance and refreshing qualities that make it uniquely versatile for pairing with various menu items.
whoShouldTry: This drink is ideal for anyone seeking a refreshing, naturally flavored beverage without artificial ingredients. Fans of cucumber water, mojitos, or herbal beverages will appreciate the flavor complexity. It suits health-conscious diners looking for interesting alternatives to plain water or sugary sodas. Those enjoying Mediterranean cuisine or fresh, garden-inspired flavors from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) will find this drink especially complementary.
worthTrying: The Cucumber Mint Lime (16 oz) is definitely worth trying for its unique, refreshing flavor profile and quality ingredients. At $3.45, it offers good value for a handcrafted beverage made with real cucumber juice and fresh herbs. The sophisticated taste elevates your dining experience beyond standard fountain drinks. Whether you are a regular CAVA customer or first-time visitor, this drink showcases the brand's commitment to fresh, flavorful, and thoughtfully prepared menu items.
